name: John McCain
role: U.S. senator from Arizona (1987-2018) and 2008 Republican presidential nominee
summary: A Republican senator and Navy veteran who combined conservative positions on taxes, abortion, guns, free trade and defense with campaign-finance reform, opposition to torture, support for comprehensive immigration reform, and a hawkish, democracy-promoting foreign policy. He called himself a Reagan Republican and a maverick, and in later years was a critic of Trump-era nationalism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Opposed publicly funded or universal coverage and coverage mandates, favoured tax credits and interstate insurance competition, and called Obama's plan a government-run system; in 2017 still wanted Obamacare replaced with a competition-based solution.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Held that states should set their own minimum wage and voted against raising the federal minimum wage 19 times, including supporting a filibuster of the increase to $7.25.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Described himself in his 2018 memoir as a Reagan Republican and proponent of free markets and less government; his convention speech said Republicans believe in open markets and government that unleashes initiative.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Most recent position: keep current income, investment and dividend rates, make the Bush cuts permanent, cut the corporate rate and shrink the estate tax. Earlier (2001, 2003) he voted against Bush cuts partly because they favoured the wealthy.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Mixed record: voted for Gramm-Leach-Bliley and regretted Sarbanes-Oxley, opposed Dodd-Frank and net neutrality, yet fought corporate abuses, backed tougher Wall Street accountability in 2008 and briefly favoured restoring Glass-Steagall in 2009.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Voted for the USA PATRIOT Act and its reauthorizations and cosponsored detention legislation, while warning that democracies sometimes overreact and promising periodic review.

legalize-drugs.rationale: At a 1999 Republican debate he opposed legalizing marijuana, called it a gateway drug, and backed more enforcement money and border interdiction.

state-harmful.rationale: Urged citizens disappointed with government to join its ranks and correct it; spent 60 years in government service and said government should work for the people.

limit-guns.rationale: His campaign program called the Second Amendment a fundamental individual right and gun control a proven failure; he opposed assault-weapon and magazine bans and waiting periods, though he backed background checks.

empower-police-military.rationale: Called for enlarging the Army and Marine Corps to 900,000 and for maintaining military leadership; as Armed Services chairman pushed defense legislation. Said nothing comparable on police authority.

decide-locally.rationale: Said states should set minimum wage, marriage definitions and abortion (via Roe reversal), but pushed federal campaign finance, immigration and gun background-check laws and argued immigration is a federal matter (Proposition 200).

traditional-family.rationale: His campaign program called the family the foundation of Western civilization and civil society and the union of one man and one woman essential to children's upbringing.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Held that marriage is a union between one man and one woman, backed state bans such as California's Proposition 8, and in 2013 said his position had not changed, though he opposed a federal marriage amendment as a states' matter.

abortion-legal.rationale: His campaign program called Roe v. Wade flawed and said it must be overturned; supported a constitutional amendment banning abortion except rape, incest or danger to the mother; Senate voting record overwhelmingly anti-abortion.

more-religion-public.rationale: Called America a Judeo-Christian nation and criticised liberal rulings showing hostility toward religion, but earlier attacked religious-right leaders as divisive; contested.

reduce-immigration.rationale: His plan raised and made flexible H-1B caps, expanded green cards and created temporary worker programs, and legalization for undocumented residents; sponsored reform bills in 2006, 2007 and 2013, opposing cuts.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Wanted a League of Democracies that could act where the UN fails, with or without Russian and Chinese approval, complementing rather than strengthening the UN.

free-trade.rationale: Called free trade the engine of the economy and the principle that should guide the nation; cited Smoot-Hawley; supported NAFTA, GATT and WTO membership.

nation-first.rationale: Said abandoning US international leadership for a spurious nationalism is unpatriotic and that America has a moral obligation to lead; insisted a good leader must be a good ally.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Urged force in Kosovo in 1999 to stop genocide, backed intervention in Libya and Syria, and said a League of Democracies should act to relieve suffering in Darfur.

open-borders.rationale: His immigration plan put securing the border first, with physical and virtual barriers and certification by border-state governors, before other reforms.

limit-growth.rationale: His climate plan stated that effective climate policy must support rapid economic growth, using market-based cap and trade rather than limiting output.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Co-sponsored cap-and-trade climate bills and proposed a 60 percent emissions cut by 2050, but after 2009 disengaged, attacked Waxman-Markey as cap and tax and denied supporting cap and trade.

expand-nuclear.rationale: In his convention speech promised to build more nuclear power plants; earlier called for 45 new reactors by 2030 and cited France as a model.

revolution-justified.rationale: Backed uprisings against Mubarak, Gaddafi and Yanukovych and urged arming Syrian rebels, but never addressed revolution as a general principle.

central-planning.rationale: Described socialist economic policies in Latin America and Africa as failed and backed open economies against them.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Opposed permanent estate-tax repeal in 2002, but his 2008 plan raised the exemption to $10 million and cut the rate to 15 percent; most recent position.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Said every time America turned protectionist it paid a heavy price, blamed Smoot-Hawley for contributing to World War II, and opposed renegotiating trade deals.

one-party-rule.rationale: Criticized China's ruling party for putting supremacy of the party above the people and called for democratic political reform there.

democracy-best.rationale: Said democracy and freedom were the nation's cause and that America is safer when the world is more democratic, urging that democracy be promoted worldwide.

political-violence-never.rationale: Supported armed resistance by Contras, Libyan rebels and the Free Syrian Army and favoured rogue-state rollback by arming opposition forces.

war-builds-character.rationale: Said in 2008 that he hates war, calling it terrible beyond imagination, and that he sought to prevent other families from sending loved ones to war.

separate-church-state.rationale: Said the nation was founded on Judeo-Christian values and criticised judicial hostility to religion, but argued for neutrality toward religion and attacked religious-right leaders as divisive; contested.

military-superiority.rationale: His campaign program committed to keeping the US military the most capable in the world, retaining its technological edge and enlarging the Army and Marines.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Called the United States a nation of ideals, not blood and soil, in his Liberty Medal speech and farewell statement.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Said Republicans believe in rewarding hard work and letting people keep the fruits of their labour, and framed fairness as equal opportunity through school choice.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Said he learned the limits of his selfish independence as a POW and that nothing brings greater happiness than serving a cause greater than oneself.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Said we live in an era of unprecedented human progress, with commerce spreading a better life, diseases eradicated and more people free than ever.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: After backing key escrow in 1997 he became an encryption-friendly senator by 1999 ('Mr. Crypto'); contested early record.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Inferred: a lifelong anti-communist who backed Reagan's hard line against the Soviet Union and defeating communism.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Inferred: he argued protectionism and closed markets contributed to world war and that open commerce and democracy build peace, rejecting the claim that capitalism leads to war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Inferred: proposed and backed numerous tax measures, including cigarette taxes in 1998, and sought low but not zero taxation.

conscription.rationale: Said in 2007-2008 that a draft is not practicable or desirable and the all-volunteer force works, while allowing he might consider a fair universal draft; earlier mused about it in 1999.

total-state.rationale: Stated Republicans believe in government that doesn't make your choices for you but gives people more choices.

universal-morality.rationale: Said principles of the Declaration of Independence are universal and that Western values are universal values on which a rule-based order rests.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Said in 2008 that anyone familiar with Jewish history cannot help but admire those who established the Jewish homeland; a staunch supporter of Israel.

school-vouchers.rationale: His campaign program said public education support should follow the child to the school the parent chooses and he voted for D.C. vouchers.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Led Republican opposition to Obama's 2009 stimulus on deficit grounds and said in 2008 that spending should be stopped first before any stimulus.

economic-freedom.rationale: Argued free trade and free capital flows have gone hand in hand with political freedom and that open economies beat one-party systems.

force-without-un.rationale: Proposed a League of Democracies able to act with or without Moscow's and Beijing's approval, and supported Kosovo, Iraq and Libya operations lacking UN authorization.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Called in 2008 for drilling new offshore wells at once and clean coal, though he opposed ANWR drilling and also backed renewables.

national-mission.rationale: Said America was created for a purpose and called for expanding the power and reach of democracy, calling this the truest realism.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said Washington's old, big-spending crowd put itself first, that Republicans lost trust through corruption, and that he fought corruption in both parties.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Affirmed that all people are created equal and endowed with inalienable rights in his 2008 acceptance speech.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Cited the Declaration's principles against despotism and said in America the people are sovereign and the system must serve them.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Advocated the 2003 Iraq invasion, rogue-state rollback and preventive military action against North Korea.

separated-powers.rationale: His judicial philosophy stressed federalism and separation of powers as a balance of power essential to preserving liberty.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Mixed: sponsored detainee-treatment limits and the Geneva compromise, yet negotiated the Military Commissions Act suspending habeas for enemy combatants and voted against restoring habeas.

party-controls-media.rationale: Criticised China for spending billions to control the internet and called for press freedom, including defending the free press against Putin.

clerical-rule.rationale: Described Iran's mullahs and Islamist leaders as seeking a theocratic caliphate and a return to theological purity, opposed to modernity.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Said in 2008 that he would rather lose an election than see his country lose a war.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Called for renewing NATO and the transatlantic partnership and a wider alliance of democracies, and rejected abandoning alliances.

people-in-arms.rationale: Said in 2007 the all-volunteer professional force is working and the best trained ever, wanting it enlarged.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Urged believing in the moral superiority of Western values over those of adversaries and rejected moral equivalence.

death-penalty.rationale: Reported to support the death penalty, mandatory prison terms and tough sentences for the gravest crimes.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Opposed federal funding of sex education and voted against spending on teen-pregnancy education and contraception, while voting for abstinence education funds.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Said in 2005 that all points of view on origins could be presented, then in 2006 that intelligent design should probably not be taught as science.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Led legislation requiring schools and libraries with federal internet subsidies to filter sexually explicit material from children.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Faulted China for pursuing economic modernization without political reform and urged support for democracy over autocratic order.

collective-defense.rationale: Treated NATO as the core of the democratic alliance, backed its protection of Georgia and Ukraine's inclusion, and urged NATO action when Russia attacked Georgia.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Demanded Russia withdraw from sovereign Georgian territory in 2008 and later supported arming Ukraine after the Crimea annexation, saying sanctions were insufficient.

space-expansion.rationale: Strong supporter of NASA, proposing a return to the Moon and a mission to Mars.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Criticised Russia for using the presence of ethnic Russians to justify intervention in Georgia and warned it might use the same argument against Crimea.

no-bailouts.rationale: Said he opposed bailouts for irresponsible actors yet proposed federal purchase of mortgages and was prominent in the 2008 rescue negotiations.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Asked in 2004 whether trade agreements should include provisions on environmental concerns and workers' rights, he answered 'No'.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: In 2008 said he favoured a proposed Arizona referendum banning affirmative action, reversing his 1998 opposition, and said he was always against quotas; most recent clear position.

delink-world-market.rationale: Urged supporting open economies in Latin America and Africa against failed socialist policies and favoured integration into global commerce.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Opposed Arizona SB 1062 in 2014, which would have let businesses refuse service on religious grounds.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Urged people to enter the ministry, run for office and serve, saying nothing brings greater happiness than serving a cause greater than yourself.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Said the Declaration's principles are universal and that democracy should be expanded worldwide rather than tailored to each civilization.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: In 1999-2004 backed partly private Social Security accounts; by 2008 said he was not for privatizing it while attacking pay-as-you-go financing.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Backed arming the Nicaraguan Contras, proposed 'rogue state rollback' to arm and train forces to overthrow hostile governments, and urged arming Syrian rebels and Ukraine.

corporate-influence.rationale: Made reducing big-money influence his signature issue through McCain-Feingold and said democracy is not for sale to those with huge checks.

democratic-peace.rationale: Said Americans are safer when the world is more democratic and built his foreign policy on spreading democracy.

non-intervention.rationale: Urged intervention in Kosovo, Libya, Syria and Georgia and argued for acting to relieve suffering and restrain aggression.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Said America must uphold and strengthen international law and the Geneva Conventions, though he opposed ratifying the CTBT.

religious-nation.rationale: Agreed America was a Judeo-Christian nation and founded on Christian principles, yet said he would vote for a Muslim and called the country one of ideals, not blood and soil.

defeat-communism.rationale: Backed Reagan's hard line against the Soviets, the Contras, and the NATO victory in the Cold War.

religion-illusion.rationale: Spoke of strong faith, thanked God for his country, and described himself as a Christian.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Said global commerce is spreading a better, freer life to millions and called free trade the engine of the economy.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Pressed FIFA to ban Iran from the 2006 World Cup over President Ahmadinejad's Holocaust denial.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Criticised Russia's treatment of LGBT people in 2013 and in later years voted for the Employment Non-Discrimination Act and backed LGBT protections in defense bills.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Condemned Putin's Russia for diminishing political freedoms and political assassinations and urged democratic pluralism.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: In 2017 said transgender service members able to serve should not be forced out and cosponsored a bill supporting them.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Warned in 2017 against hardening resentment toward immigrants, refugees and minorities, 'especially Muslims', and said he would vote for a Muslim candidate.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Said in America the people are sovereign and political authority comes through the consent of citizens.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Called for a larger, better-equipped military and strong defense.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Championed NATO and an alliance of democracies against Russia and China.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Led opposition to repeal of Don't Ask, Don't Tell in 2010, but later supported LGBT protections in defense bills and defended transgender service; contested.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Opposed what he called liberal opinions adopting active hostility toward religion rather than neutrality.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Backed mandatory prison terms, the death penalty and tougher sentencing.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Inferred: career naval officer and a defender of Second Amendment rights including personal protection.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Warned in 2017 against a turn toward old ties of blood and race, urging universal values instead.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Backed first-use of force in Iraq 2003, Kosovo, Libya and rogue-state rollback.

future-generations.rationale: Said environmental challenges affect the quality of life we leave our children and future generations and pledged conservation stewardship.

capital-controls.rationale: Cited America's long support for free flows of capital and free trade as part of promoting open societies.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Backed Gramm-Rudman automatic deficit controls and proposed requiring a three-fifths vote in Congress to raise taxes and a line-item veto.

farm-price-support.rationale: Opposed subsidising large commercial farms and ethanol mandates, wanted to cap subsidies and open foreign markets, while expressing support for small farmers.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Voted against the CTBT, backed missile defence and said America would not trust the balance of terror; in 2008 favoured reducing the arsenal to encourage others to follow.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: His campaign program endorsed strict mandatory penalties for criminals who use or illegally possess firearms; described as a proponent of mandatory sentencing in general.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: His plan required undocumented immigrants to learn English as part of a path to legal status; voted in 2007 to make English the federal government's official language.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Criticised China's efforts to control the internet.

close-ties-china.rationale: Called for pursuing cooperation with China but pressing it, and for strengthening alliances with democracies as the core of US policy.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Proposed in 2008 that higher-income seniors pay higher Medicare Part D premiums.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Campaigned against earmarks and corporate welfare, attacking a bill giving oil companies subsidies as corporate welfare.

multipolar-world.rationale: Defended the US-led liberal order and America's indispensability to peace and stability.

notes: Some positions moved over time: opposed Bush tax cuts in 2001 and 2003 but backed making them permanent by 2008; earlier supported partly private Social Security accounts, later disavowed privatization; opposed the MLK holiday in 1983 and later reversed; moved from an opposed-then-favoured stance on a ban on affirmative action; softened on LGBT issues in later years while keeping his stated opposition to same-sex marriage. Most recent clear positions are used.
